import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        String a = scanner.next();
        StringBuilder b = new StringBuilder();
        boolean judge = false;
        
        enum State { NORMAL, DOT_CHECK, AT_CHECK }
        State state = State.NORMAL;
        
        int i = 0;
        while (i < a.length()) {
            switch (state) {
                case NORMAL:
                    if (a.charAt(i) == 'd' && i != 0 && i != a.length() - 3) {
                        if (i + 2 < a.length() && a.charAt(i+1) == 'o' && a.charAt(i+2) == 't') {
                            b.append('.');
                            i += 3;
                            state = State.NORMAL;
                        } else {
                            b.append(a.charAt(i));
                            i++;
                            state = State.NORMAL;
                        }
                    } else if (a.charAt(i) == 'a' && i != 0 && i != a.length() - 2 && !judge) {
                        if (i + 1 < a.length() && a.charAt(i+1) == 't') {
                            b.append('@');
                            i += 2;
                            judge = true;
                            state = State.NORMAL;
                        } else {
                            b.append(a.charAt(i));
                            i++;
                            state = State.NORMAL;
                        }
                    } else {
                        b.append(a.charAt(i));
                        i++;
                        state = State.NORMAL;
                    }
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(b.toString());
    }
}
